note: Benton County park on the north shore of Little Rock Lake, 2.5 mi east of Rice; the campground sits in woods north of the park's fields, back from the lake. The county no longer keeps a swim beach (the shore is a restored native buffer). Generators are not allowed. County Road 2 in front of the park is under major construction all summer 2027, with some closures (county notice, October 2026). --Claude
summary: County page + Rec1 catalog read: electric sites $40 for 2 adults (+$4 extra adult), 7-27 nights $31.50, season $1,800; online-only booking on Rec1 (stored 'FCFS always, not reservable' corrected); 39 RV sites (2-40) + 4 tent sites; 2026 season May 8 - Sep 14; showers, dump. Every RV site is also sold as a $1,800 season block, booked two months before nightly stays open: seasonal share unmeasured. Not waterfront kept.
